limitations: Judged from logs and tests; nothing was run. Counts quoted from logs. All 20 headers show 72051d193 and summary.tsv ends with done. The statement that the PG-202 RLS session test passes rather than skips is inferred from the integration count (21 passed + 5 skipped). The 90 file renames were not individually diffed. PASS depends on the documented web thresholds (branches >=80) and on judging legacy-file gaps by the diff; under a flat 90% rule the new web files' 81-88% branches and CheckConflicts legacy branches (70%) would not pass. The lint-driven cache-refresh change has no RED by design.
